title: Component displays incorrect hardcoded text 'Portal' instead of RAG demo UI

evidence.quote:
{/* RAG Demo — open access for Ben/Nick */}
<Route path="/rag-demo" element={<RAGDemo />} />

reasoning: The RAGDemo component returns a hardcoded div with text 'Portal', which appears to be copy-paste scaffolding that was never replaced with actual RAG demo functionality. The route comment explicitly states this is a 'RAG Demo' for 'open access for Ben/Nick', suggesting it should provide meaningful RAG-related UI, not generic placeholder text. This is almost certainly a bug rather than intended behavior.
reproduction: Navigate to /rag-demo route and observe the page displays only 'Portal' text instead of any RAG demo interface
recommendation: Implement the actual RAG demo UI with appropriate components, forms, and functionality for demonstrating retrieval-augmented generation capabilities. If this is intentional placeholder state, add a TODO comment and more descriptive text like 'RAG Demo - Coming Soon'.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are included in the feature definition (tests array is empty), so there is no automated verification of the component's rendered output or functionality
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a React Testing Library test that verifies RAGDemo renders expected UI elements (e.g., input fields, submit button, results area) rather than just placeholder text
minimumFixScope: src/src/pages/RAGDemo.tsx - replace hardcoded 'Portal' div with actual RAG demo implementation
